results.title: Jensen, Devers slug way to Player of the Week honors
results.description: Although their clubs are no longer in the mix for postseason contention, Royals rookie Carter Jensen and Giants star Rafael Devers are still giving fans plenty to cheer about, and their September exploits led to both taking home the most recent Player of the Week Awards in their respective leagues. results.title: Trump’s 9/11 rescue story goes viral: Did firefighters carry him from a collapsing building? | Watch
results.description: U.S. President Donald Trump recalled a dramatic moment during 9/11 memorial service, which involved two firefighters who rushed to pull him to safety after they feared a U.S. Steel structure was about to collapse. Trump, during a 9/11 praised the firefighters for their quick response, claiming that they literally lifted him and carried him away from the danger.
